label: Episode 44
logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

picks.logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
picks.why_it_works: opens on a clear dramatic question; ends on a raised stake; mostly self-contained, needs one line of setup.

standalone_notes: relies on prior knowledge of ALEXANDER, BLOND NOBLEMAN, CATHERINE, GUARD

CLIP: episode 44, 1 segment(s), 46s
[00:17.40-00:19.30] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming): "Do something!"
[00:19.40-00:22.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
[00:21.80-00:24.40] ACTION: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
[00:22.00-00:24.40] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.
[00:24.40-00:27.80] CAMERA: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.
[00:25.20-00:28.00] CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful): "Alexander... I thought you had died."
[00:27.80-00:31.20] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.
[00:28.40-00:31.00] CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping): "Do you know what this did to me?"
[00:31.20-00:32.40] CAMERA: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.
[00:31.20-00:32.40] CATHERINE (Pleading): "I mourned you."
[00:32.40-00:34.00] CAMERA: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.
[00:32.40-00:34.00] CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling): "I waited for you."
[00:34.00-00:35.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.
[00:34.20-00:38.80] CATHERINE (Heartbroken): "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
[00:35.80-00:38.80] CAMERA: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
[00:38.80-00:41.20] CAMERA: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
[00:38.90-00:41.20] CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing): "I never stopped loving you."
[00:41.20-00:42.80] ACTION: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
[00:41.20-00:42.80] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
[00:42.80-00:46.40] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
[00:44.20-00:46.40] CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt): "You don't remember?"
[00:46.40-00:49.00] CAMERA: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
[00:46.60-00:48.80] CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding): "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
[00:49.00-00:51.00] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
[00:49.20-00:51.00] ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable): "You were never my Duchess."
[00:51.00-00:53.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
[00:51.10-00:52.80] CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading): "But I loved you!"
[00:53.00-00:55.60] CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.
[00:53.00-00:55.50] ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting): "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
[00:55.60-00:59.00] CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.
[00:56.20-00:58.20] CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained): "No!"
[00:59.00-01:02.40] CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.
[00:59.80-01:02.40] CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying): "I loved you before all this!"
[01:02.40-01:03.65] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.
[01:02.50-01:03.40] ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting): "Did you?"
